description: The pie chart represents the distribution of time or proportion between two categories. The chart is divided into three slices, although one slice is not labeled or colored distinctly. The largest slice is orange and represents 60.9s, accounting for approximately 69.92% of the total. The second slice is blue, labeled as "Efficient deployment", and represents 26.2s, making up around 30.08%. The third slice is gray and appears to be negligible in size, but its exact proportion is not specified. The chart includes percentage labels inside the two larger slices, and the slices are visually distinct due to their colors. The blue slice is also labeled with text outside the chart, adjacent to its corresponding slice.
